description: Optimize the hexagonal P6_3/mmc bulk structure of graphite with a van der Waals correction.
user_prompt: Optimize the hexagonal (P6_3/mmc) bulk structure of graphite. Report the final converged energy and lattice constants (a and c).

references: Jain, Ong, Hautier, Chen, Richards, Dacek, Cholia, Gunter, Skinner, Ceder & Persson, APL Mater. 1, 011002 (2013)
method.modeling: AB-stacked graphite hexagonal bulk cell with space group P6_3/mmc; elemental carbon formula unit is one atom.
method.rationale: The target energy is the Materials Project mp-48 GGA final energy per atom, equal to energy per formula unit for elemental carbon. Only the total energy is scored; the vdW correction is retained to recover the interlayer spacing against the Trucano-Chen graphite structure, while MP's plain GGA lattice constant c is only a diagnostic. The +/-0.5 eV/f.u. absolute tolerance covers PAW dataset, cutoff, smearing, and modest dispersion-correction energy shifts while still flagging wrong carbon allotropes.
